name: Hananiah
overview: Hananiah was a male figure identified as a descendant of Bebai. He is notably recognized for having married a foreign wife, an act recorded in Ezra 10:28. There is no additional information on his tribal affiliation or other personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Hananiah means 'YHWH is gracious' in Hebrew. This proper name reflects a common theophoric element invoking God's grace, though it was not specifically given by God according to the record in Ezra 10:28.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Hananiah as a descendant of Bebai, establishing a direct familial link. Beyond this, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hananiah's significance lies in his representation among those who had married foreign wives during the post-exilic period. His inclusion in Ezra 10:28 highlights the challenges faced by the returning Israelites in maintaining covenantal purity and obedience to God's commands. This account serves as a sobering reminder of the need for faithfulness to God's covenant, a principle ultimately fulfilled in Christ.
